candidate_inputs.note: The prior CSV's SOURCE_SPAN_VERIFIED labels are historical metadata only. Exactly 42 巨门 rows were independently rechecked; W08-743 onward belongs to later sections and is out of scope. No records were padded.

major_findings: The base speech/mental-effort income reading is separate from the conditional dispute warning when the source-recommended speech-based path is not followed.
The wealth formation clause requires 禄、权、科同会 plus 辅佐吉曜; the arrogance/exclusion countercondition remains attached to that context.
The source's “巨门之财，不过一代” explicitly requires consulting 子女宫; additional named child-palace modifiers are preserved rather than generalized.
巨门化忌, 太阳化忌, 天刑, and the stated 刑法纪律行业 exception remain separate conditional branches.
The listed 火、铃星、空劫、大耗 configuration and the 巨门、擎羊、天刑 configuration are retained as separate source statements.
The 巨门/太阳 configuration with 吉化 and the 命宫禄马 alternative remain distinct alternatives; language talent is preserved as a linked statement.
The 子午、辰戌、巳亥 branches remain separate. Source-ordered hardship/breakout, trust/development, and fame/profit paths remain NATAL path annotations, not fixed-duration models.

Sixteen candidate conditions/targets were revised after source recheck, including the source's 辰戌 (not 辰 only) 巨门化忌反格, the 独坐 condition for 巳亥巨门, the generic scope of 巨门化禄 retail advice, and the literal connective “及”.
No new source-text ambiguity was found in the printed p86–p87 巨门 passage; earlier P05 gaps are carried forward unchanged.
